excerpt: Ethereum ETF coverage is plentiful, so this is a direct analysis of the most important current developments. The dominant theme right now is persistent institutional outflow from spot ETH ETFs. Lookonchain shows ETH ETFs bleeding $132.41M in a single day (Nov 12) and $422.51M over seven days, with Cointelegraph confirming continued net outflows across BTC, ETH, and XRP products.

The brief relief on Nov 10 -- where ETH outflows shrank to just $1.3M -- was erased the following session with $144.8M leaving, exactly as @alver1301 flagged. BlackRock-related selling pressure is visible too: @conorfkenny cites $90.76M of ETH sold by BlackRock ETF vehicles, and @WhaleInsider notes $75.20M in ETF client ETH sales against only $53.02M of buying a day earlier. This is a clear distribution regime, not accumulation. Price action confirms it: @DylanTeil reports ETH breaking below $2K amid $530M in liq
